# Feature: Map tile — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #55 (Map tile) from Vision and Information before it is used in real levels. Effect: briefly shows the whole level. Unique: a brief full reveal that fades while you play on. Useful: a memory test, you must act on what you glimpsed. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** briefly shows the whole level.

**So that** a memory test, you must act on what you glimpsed.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Map tile for the first time in its teaching room (mech-55-map-tile-room). Teaching moment: First room: the map tile at the entrance to a branching room, with three seconds of full view. A player who glances and runs takes the branch that looked shortest and finds the lock they have no key for, which teaches that the glimpse has to be read before it is acted on because it will not come back. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Stepping on it consumes it and shows the whole level as an overlay for three seconds while play continues, then the view fades back
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: What you did not memorise, you lose

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Map tile's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-55-map-tile-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/vision-and-information.yml mechanic #55.
